texas_regions: Classing by office to Oct 22: South Texas (Corpus Christi) 951k bales classed, West Texas (Lubbock 42k, Lamesa 19k, Abilene 22k) 83k. South Texas is well advanced; West Texas, where abandonment decides the crop, has barely started and is projected from drought and ratings until its classing builds in November.
notes: Texas October FSA failed acres (9.8% of planted) are not final: failed acres are reported to FSA with a lag, and the December–January releases settle it. The abandonment projection uses this season's drought and ratings readings against what similar readings meant for final abandonment in past seasons.
